description:
Size your holder segments

How many reachable subscribers (verified, not opted out) are in each holder segment, and the size of the audience selected: `all`, `new_7d` (joined in the last 7 days), `churned` (sold everything), `reduced_50` (cut their position by half or more), `whales` (top 1% or $10k+), `top_10`, `top_25`, `top_50`, `top_100`. `audience.reachableByDM` is how many of those the bot can DM on Telegram or Discord. Owner or manager; wallet session only.

The audience size is who a broadcast or a reward to that selection would reach. A token page id repeats across chains, so `chain` decides which token's ownership is checked.

Needs Sign in with Chain Daddy (scope api:read).

id.description: The token page's id (the registration's numeric token id)

segments.description: Comma-separated segments to size as one audience. An unknown name is 400.

tierId.description: Narrow everything to one holder group

name: get_holder_segments

count.description: Subscribers in ANY selected segment (everyone reachable when none is selected)

title: Size your holder segments
